svg.title: Integrals over adjacent intervals add
svg.desc: A positive curve y = f(x) over three marked points a, b and c on the x-axis. The region under the curve from a to b is shaded crimson and the region from b to c is shaded blue. The equation above reads: the integral of f from a to c equals the integral from a to b plus the integral from b to c.

text.tspan: Adjacent intervals: the two areas add to the whole.
